title: Count Subtrees With Max Distance Between Cities
sourceKind: official-page-blocked; statement and examples from WebSearch result summaries citing leetcode.com/problems/count-subtrees-with-max-distance-between-cities and related mirrors
summary: n cities are connected by n-1 bidirectional edges forming a tree. For each d from 1 to n-1, count subsets of cities that are connected (within the subset) whose largest pairwise distance (in edges) is exactly d. Return the counts as an array.
officialConstraints: 2 <= n <= 15; edges has length n-1; 1 <= u, v <= n; u != v; the edges form a tree.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps n at 10 because subset enumeration is 2^n; the full LeetCode limit is 15.
